screen: Leave-one-county-out two-covariate residual correction using provided M2/M3 facility metadata; unregistered

method.outcome: Frozen cross-fitted S1 orthogonalized-disagreement residual; source artifact is verified and never refit.
method.corrections: M2 F facility_wikidata_link_share and M3 F facility_incoming_address_mismatch_share, selected because they are the M2/M3 features in the frozen Mx4 redundancy audit.
method.validation: Within each official region, hold one FIPS county out; fit intercept and both feature coefficients using supported tracts from all other counties in that region; predict the held county. Every supported tract is predicted exactly once.
method.scaling: Each covariate is centered/scaled on the training counties only; zero training SD uses scale 1. OLS coefficients are estimated with np.linalg.lstsq; no tuning or labels.
method.baseline: Uncorrected S1 residual: correction prediction is fixed at zero; baseline SSE=sum(residual^2) on exactly the same held-out tracts.
method.metric: Per-county and per-region delta-R2=1-model SSE / baseline SSE (equivalently (baseline SSE-model SSE)/baseline SSE). Pooled delta uses all paired OOF rows; macro mean gives equal weight to four region deltas.
method.uncertainty: Paired county bootstrap with replacement, resampling supported held-out county records within each region; report pooled, macro-mean and per-region percentile 95% intervals.
method.county_assignment: First five numeric characters of the official 11-digit tract GEOID (county FIPS).
method.support: One paired mask requiring frozen residual and both provided M2/M3 covariates defined; no imputation or outcome-dependent exclusions.
method.interpretation_limit: Label-free provided-feature residual association; not hidden-target accuracy, causal evidence, or estimator-promotion evidence.

paired_county_bootstrap.resampling: paired held-county OOF predictions; sample supported counties with replacement within each official region, preserving county counts per region

interpretation: The two-covariate correction failed one or more county-transfer thresholds; retain the unweighted frozen S1 residual and do not integrate the correction.
